# HellBrowsers

Minimal browser co-op inspired by Helldivers. Solo or peer-to-peer multiplayer.

```{=html}
<div style="position:relative;max-width:1100px;margin:1rem auto;aspect-ratio:16/10;">
  <iframe 
    src="index.html" 
    style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:2px solid #333;border-radius:6px;"
    allow="autoplay; fullscreen; gamepad"
    loading="lazy">
  </iframe>
</div>
```

## Controls

| Action | Input |
|--------|-------|
| Move | `W A S D` |
| Aim / Fire | Mouse + LMB |
| Sprint | `Shift` |
| Reload | `R` |
| Stratagems | Hold `Ctrl` + directional WASD |
| Pause | `Esc` |

**Stratagem codes** (hold Ctrl): ↓↓↑→ Resupply · →→↑ Orbital · ↑↓→←↑ Reinforce · ↑→→ Eagle

Survive waves, then extract by standing in the blue circle after wave 3.
